evidence: Enumerated every refusal / absence / unchanged leg across gates and scored dimensions and checked each for a same-criterion success case. Global rule: functional prompt.md:13 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review.'; prompt.md:17 requires role replays to send current version values and 'Send the same fresh request as Rafael ... as its control; a refusal for a duplicate, a skip or a full stage does not count as the role refusal', and 'A refusal that only reports the card as changed or out of date does not count'. Gates: hro_gate_render pairs wrong-password-stays-signed-out with a correct sign-in showing a usable workspace (render prompt.md: 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'). hro_gate_shared is positive-only. Functional pairings (scored/functional/judge.toml): hro_job_open ('the successful opening is the control', l.31); hro_add_email_rules (same address on a different job accepted 'the control', l.49); hro_move_one_stage (skips refused + one-stage moves must work, l.58); hro_reject_reason (blank refused + reasoned reject, l.85); hro_reject_hired ('A rejection of a non-hired card is the control', l.94); hro_reopen (other stage refused + own-stage reopen, l.103); hro_interview_full ('the two cards that entered Interview are the control', l.112); hro_undo_full (same-kind control after a freed place, l.130); hro_refused_put_back ('Earlier successful moves on this page are the control' plus positive reason/focus legs, l.139); hro_mgr_early_refused ('their late-stage moves are the control', l.157); hro_mgr_other_job (own manager's move is the control, l.166); hro_observer_readonly / hro_candidate_no_staff / hro_anonymous (session control + Rafael's identical successful request per kind; kinds without a working control left out and 'the row is 0 only if no kind has a successful control', l.175/184/193); hro_refusal_status ('If none of these replays was refused, this row is 0', and the 409 on C's stale replay presupposes a working move, l.202); hro_stale_refused ('The original successful move is the control', l.211); hro_bulk_all_or_none / hro_bulk_places / hro_undo_conflict / hro_undo_once each name a successful same-kind control (l.229/238/256/265); hro_activity_refusals ('The successful actions' lines are the control', l.283); hro_notes (permitted notes must succeed, Observer reads both, l.292); hro_msg_compose ('A normal send is the control', l.319); hro_unread_counts (no-rise legs paired with 'rises by exactly two' within 15 s in the same row, l.346); hro_unread_scrolled_up (no jump paired with notice within 15 s, l.355); hro_seen (not-seen-after-Observer paired with seen-after-Tomas, l.364); hro_thread_access (Ingrid/Observer/Noor refusals + Rafael's read and send controls and Mei/Bill writes, l.373); hro_candidate_private ('own applications and conversations load with their messages (the control)', Rafael's identical read succeeded, 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data is 0', l.400); hro_restart ('not loaded again' paired with recorded seeded order/note and own records, l.418). Polish (scored/polish/judge.toml): hro_pol_failed_send (nothing sent + resend 'sent once'); hro_pol_session_resume (nothing sent without sign-in + resend after sign-in 'is the positive control'; Mei's empty boxes paired with Rafael's drafts still there); hro_pol_live_board / hro_pol_live_thread ('If no update arrives within 15 seconds, preservation cannot be shown and this row is 0'). Visual is Likert craft with no negative legs. Broken-app probes: a blank shell, login-only screen or static seed response fails both gates and the in-dimension gate (functional prompt.md:11-13 zero every binary criterion). A server refusing every mutation fails every refusal row through its named success control; a read-only app gets nothing from Observer/candidate/anonymous rows ('row is 0 only if no kind has a successful control'). An app with no live updates cannot earn the 'does not rise / does not move / still not seen' legs because each sits beside a must-appear leg in the same row. Conforming alternative (hides forbidden controls instead of refusing in UI) is protected: 'hiding it is optional' plus replay of the captured request (prompt.md:31). Colderwater lessons checked for this row: lesson 15 (weak restart) - hro_restart rereads many records plus seeded data; lesson 9 (judge over-passes) - 'Report every step ... A step you skipped or did differently fails' (functional prompt.md:23-25, polish prompt.md:20-22); lesson 16 (double penalty) - refused-action Activity lines deducted only in hro_activity_refusals (prompt.md:27). No instance bears negatively on row 30. Minor P3 observations, not blocking: (a) hro_candidate_private's own-card 'rejection reason / rejected-from stage' sub-leg relies on Rafael's K-protocol rejection of Tomas's card; if reject is dead that sub-leg is checked vacuously (the row still has its own-data control, the seeded Lena rejection APP-301 and seeded APP-101 note as real leak targets for the board/Activity/notes replays, and the dead reject is deducted in hro_reject_reason). (b) hro_mgr_early_refused names only 'their late-stage moves' as its control and lacks the 'kind without a working staff control is left out' sentence of the Observer/candidate/anonymous rows; prompt.md:13/17 supply the same-kind (Rafael) control generically, so the bar is covered but less consistently worded. Risk=true because no measured weak/mutated-app discrimination run exists: raw-evidence-index scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; the scripted golden harness (workspace.cjs, results/workspace.json; hashes verified) exercises only the reference app. This verdict is source/design evidence, not a judge run.
